title: Technical Systems Engineer (Pune) - Splunk
teaser: Join us as a Technical Systems Engineer to drive digital transformation and adoption initiatives, supporting field teams and employees. You will design and implement digital adoption solutions, collaborate with cross-functional teams, and leverage data-driven insights. Ideal for candidates with experience in digital adoption, consulting, or system administration.
description:
Meet the Team

Join the Global Field Enablement Digital Transformation and Adoption team, which drives transformation and adoption initiatives that improve the productivity, scale, and experience of field teams and employees. The team partners across GTM, IT, Finance, HCM, and Enablement to deliver digital adoption strategies, system and process transformation, automation, and seamless user experiences.

Your Impact

As part of the Digital Transformation and Adoption team, you will help address transformation and adoption needs across the organization by designing, implementing, and supporting digital adoption solutions. You will serve as a subject matter expert, collaborate with cross-functional teams, and use data-driven insights to improve user productivity, performance, and experience.

Deliver and maintain Digital Adoption solutions to provide a seamless experience for internal teams and end users.

Implement digital adoption strategies and solutions across functions including GTM, Finance, IT, HCM, and Enablement.

Participate in the solutioning, design, development, implementation, and ongoing support of Digital Adoption Platform (DAP) solutions.

Identify and implement process improvements that optimize user productivity and performance, using metrics and insights to provide recommendations and share best practices.

Collaborate with cross-functional teams on complex projects, serving as a subject matter expert and contributing to automation and system transformation initiatives.

Minimum Qualifications

2+ years of experience in digital adoption, consulting, enablement, systems and tools, system administration, operations, or a related field.

Experience participating in the solutioning, design, development, implementation, and support of digital adoption solutions.

Experience working on complex projects involving multiple teams and cross-functional stakeholders.

Experience with digital adoption or enablement platforms such as Salesforce, WalkMe, Whatfix, Mindtickle, or Seismic.

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Information Systems, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with enterprise systems and tools such as Gong, Confluence, Jira, Lucidchart, Okta, SailPoint, Workday, Anaplan, or SAP Ariba.

Experience with AI agent development or GenAI technologies and platforms such as Cursor or n8n.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to use quantitative and qualitative insights to identify opportunities for improvement.

Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to communicate complex information clearly to cross-functional stakeholders.

Highly organized, creative, collaborative, and adaptable, with a customer-focused approach and ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment.

Why Cisco? 

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere. 

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.
